issues.message: add_lumped_rlc(...) + a TFSF plane-wave source is numerically unstable (fields diverge, C-independent). This is the TFSF↔lumped-ADE coupling, not a missing circuit path — a PEC-gap structure does NOT cure it (tested, #425). Use the validated PORT-fed lane (add_port + forward(rlc_values_override=...)) for varactor/tunable-load design.
